settingsPrivacy.contentPrivacyIntro: Your privacy is critically important to us. We collect, use, and store personal information only for the specific purposes described below:
settingsPrivacy.collectText: When you register or use certain features, we may collect:
settingsPrivacy.collectPoint1: Your name, email address, and phone number.
settingsPrivacy.collectPoint2: Device identifiers and usage data (pages visited, features used, timestamps).
settingsPrivacy.collectPoint3: Information automatically through cookies and similar technologies.
settingsPrivacy.useTextIntro: We use your personal data to:
settingsPrivacy.usePoint1: Provide and maintain the services you request.
settingsPrivacy.usePoint2: Authenticate your identity and protect against fraud.
settingsPrivacy.usePoint3: Send you important updates, notifications, and promotional materials (you can opt out at any time).
settingsPrivacy.usePoint4: Analyze usage trends, diagnose technical issues, and enhance our platform.
settingsPrivacy.sharingTextIntro: We never sell your personal information. We may share data with:
settingsPrivacy.sharingPoint1: Service providers who perform functions on our behalf (e.g., email delivery, analytics).
settingsPrivacy.sharingPoint2: Legal authorities when required by law or to protect our rights.
settingsPrivacy.sharingPoint3: Other users, only if you choose to share a device or group with them.
settingsPrivacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures (encryption in transit and at rest, access controls, monitoring) to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure.
settingsPrivacy.rightsPoint1: Access, correct, or delete your personal data.
settingsPrivacy.rightsPoint2: Restrict or object to certain types of processing.
settingsPrivacy.rightsPoint4: Export your data in machine-readable format.
settingsPrivacy.retentionText: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined above or to comply with legal obligations.
settingsPrivacy.childrenText: Our services are not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.
settingsPrivacy.contentTermsIntro: Welcome to our application. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. Please read them carefully:
settingsPrivacy.acceptanceText: By creating an account or using any feature, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these terms.
settingsPrivacy.accountText: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for any activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use.
settingsPrivacy.allowedTextIntro: You may use the app only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms. You agree not to:
settingsPrivacy.allowedPoint1: Reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract source code.
settingsPrivacy.allowedPoint2: Use the service to harass, defame, or infringe upon the rights of others.
settingsPrivacy.allowedPoint3: Upload viruses or other malicious code.
settingsPrivacy.ipText: All content, trademarks, and data within the app belong to us or our licensors. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written permission.
settingsPrivacy.terminationText: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access at any time, without notice, if you violate these terms or if we believe your actions may harm the service or other users.
settingsPrivacy.disclaimerText: The service is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or that the service will be error-free. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we disclaim all liability for any damages arising from your use of the service.
settingsPrivacy.changesText: We may modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of material changes via email or in-app notification. Continued use after such changes constitutes acceptance.
settingsPrivacy.lawText: These terms are governed by the laws of your jurisdiction (for example, California, USA) without regard to conflict of law principles.
